facts.text: Criticality: self-sustaining chain reaction — k = 1 (subcritical k<1, supercritical k>1)

facts.text: FBR: produces more fissile fuel than it consumes; fast neutrons, no moderator; MOX fuel (Pu + U); U-238 blanket → Pu-239; liquid sodium coolant (low dissolved oxygen for corrosion resistance)

facts.text: Critical mass depends on shape, density, purity; applies to reactors and weapons
